strings.zh: 我儿子是捉精灵的天才哟！{SCROLL}才两天时间{NEWLINE}就把枯叶市周围的精灵抓齐了！
strings.en: My son is a genius at catching Pokémon!{SCROLL}In just two days, he caught every{NEWLINE}Pokémon around Vermilion City!

strings.zh: 小豪『嗯,枯叶市周围的精灵{NEWLINE}已经收集齐了。{CLEAR}准备下去其他地方继续收集吧。
strings.en: Goh: Yep, I’ve caught every Pokémon{NEWLINE}around Vermilion City.{SCROLL}Time to head somewhere else and keep{NEWLINE}collecting.

strings.zh: 我儿子的梦想是{NEWLINE}成为世界第一精灵收集者！{CLEAR}他捉精灵的技术可是非常厉害的。
strings.en: My son’s dream is to be the world’s{NEWLINE}greatest Pokémon collector!{SCROLL}He’s amazing at catching Pokémon.

strings.zh: 小豪『你有什么事吗？{SCROLL}小豪『什么？{NEWLINE}枯叶市工地的事件我怎么看？{CLEAR}我马上就出去旅行了,{CLEAR}想太多这种没用的事{CLEAR}只会成为梦想路上的绊脚石。
strings.en: Goh: Need something?{SCROLL}Goh: What? What do I think about the{NEWLINE}Vermilion construction site?{SCROLL}I’m about to set off on my journey.{NEWLINE}Overthinking pointless{CLEAR}stuff like that...{SCROLL}...only trips you up on the road to your{NEWLINE}dream.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 既然住在海边,{NEWLINE}当然就要吃美味的海鲜料理了。{SCROLL}可是我现在手头的调料不够足,{NEWLINE}没法做出让我满意的料理。{CLEAR}能麻烦你帮我找些原料来吗？{SCROLL}我需要的原料有{NEWLINE}1份浅水盐和1个大蘑菇。
strings.en: Living by the sea, I want to cook{NEWLINE}delicious seafood, naturally.{SCROLL}But I don’t have enough seasonings on{NEWLINE}hand to make a dish I’m happy with.{SCROLL}Could I trouble you to find me some{NEWLINE}ingredients?{SCROLL}I need 1 Shoal Salt and 1 Big Mushroom.

strings.zh: 哇,你把我需要的原料都找来了！？{NEWLINE}真是万分感谢！{CLEAR}那我就不客气地收下啦。
strings.en: Wow, you found everything I need?!{NEWLINE}Thank you so much!{SCROLL}Then I’ll gladly take them.

strings.zh: 真的很感谢你花了这么大力气{NEWLINE}找来这些原料。{CLEAR}作为感谢请收下这个。
strings.en: Thank you for going to so much{NEWLINE}trouble to find these.{CLEAR}Please take this as thanks.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 多亏你送的原料,{NEWLINE}我现在可以做出美味的料理了。
strings.en: Thanks to your ingredients, I can cook{NEWLINE}delicious food now.

strings.zh: 这是我平时烧饭时{NEWLINE}积在锅底的灰。{SCROLL}这锅底灰又名百草霜{NEWLINE}能治百病呢。
strings.en: This is the soot that builds up on the{NEWLINE}bottom of my pot when I cook.{SCROLL}They call it ‘hundred-herb frost,’ and{NEWLINE}they say it cures any illness.
strings.notes: 百草霜 = pot soot, a traditional Chinese remedy; which item is given isn't visible.
